title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #080 · 명화 믹스 · 대각 띠·매끈 · 5영역(피카소+마티스+폴록+반 고흐+로스코) · 풀커버 · hourglass bombshell · 정면 한 손 힙 · Black · 배경 천문대 · 메이크업 없음(블루블랙)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, wolf cut chocolate brown hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 14% of the way down her figure from the top, about 41% of the way down her figure from the top, about 58% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries Picasso style cubist planes, fragmented geometric shapes and angular faces in ochre, blue and terracotta. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out shapes, bold seaweed-like leaf forms in flat cobalt blue, coral and yellow. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Jackson Pollock style action painting, tangled drips and splatters of black, white, orange and teal flung across her skin. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Van Gogh Starry Night style swirling thick brushstrokes in deep ultramarine, cobalt and glowing yellow, big spiralling skies flowing over her curves. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries Rothko style colour fields, soft-edged stacked rectangles of deep crimson, orange and maroon glowing like light. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, her left hand resting on her hip and her right arm relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy deep emerald leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in deep emerald lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, bare natural brows and bare natural lips in her own deep tones, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a bright observatory hall with a pale floor, a large white telescope dome behind her, a standard-height door and a short steel stair, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
